description: This file defines the SendMessageActivity class in an Android application, which handles sharing and sending a text message to a contact via a direct share feature. It manages UI interactions, intent resolution, contact selection, and message dispatching.

classes.name: SendMessageActivity
classes.description: An Android Activity enabling users to send a message to a contact, handling intent resolution, contact selection, and message display.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the UI, resolves share intent, and handles contact selection.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles the result from contact selection activity, updating the contact ID and UI.

methods.name: resolveIntent
methods.description: Checks if the incoming intent is a text sharing intent and extracts message and contact ID.

methods.name: prepareUi
methods.description: Updates the UI elements with contact information and message body.

methods.name: selectContact
methods.description: Starts the contact selection activity for the user to choose a contact.

methods.name: send
methods.description: Shows a toast message simulating message sending and closes the activity.
